name: Rose Academy
source:
In this detective visual novel, you play as a young agent sent to an elite girls' academy to investigate the suspicious death of a top student. Interrogate suspects, collect evidence, and build romantic relationships — will you uncover the truth or fall for someone's charm?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600360/]Steam[/url]]
